meta.legend: P = permitted by right, A = administrator exception, S = special exception, C = conditional use, blank = not permitted (§911.01F).
meta.mapping_assumption: single_family = Single-Unit Detached. townhouse_duplex = Single-Unit Attached or Two-Unit. small_apartment (3–19 units) = Three-Unit for 3 units and Multi-Unit for 4–19. large_apartment (20+ units) = Multi-Unit. Subdistrict codes use the base column (R1D-VL uses R1D, GT-A uses GT, RIV-MU uses the RIV MU column). The unlabeled second DT column is blank in the code and is not mapped to a district. Where Three-Unit and Multi-Unit differ, use_notes says so.
meta.code_access: §911.02 was read from a saved copy of https://ecode360.com/45476524#45476524 (Chapter 911). Column alignment was checked with the startcol attributes, including the Special, DT, and RIV groups. needs_expert_review stays true.
meta.warning: This is decision support, not a legal determination. needs_expert_review is true on every row. Overlays, lot-width tests, and review procedure are not applied automatically.
